answer: Price each identity to a one-time non-refundable bond locked like seasoned timber: it only hardens into weight across many epochs of peer-audited work, never minted in bulk. Standing then pools slowly like a lagoon filling drop by drop as separately-funded peers co-sign real deliveries; a fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its vouches fold back and the lagoon never fills. Only that slow accrual becomes a haven of genuine standing. An honest agent posts one bond once; a sybil farm pays a fresh bond plus a full slow climb per head, linear and never free.
